crossRefs.note: Lift up your heads, you gates! Be lifted up, you everlasting doors, and the King of glory will come in.
I had scarcely passed from them, when I found him whom my soul loves. I held him, and would not let him go, until I had…
When they got up into the boat, the wind ceased.
Those who were in the boat came and worshiped him, saying, “You are truly the Son of God!”
He got into the boat with them; and the wind ceased, and they were very amazed among themselves, and marveled;
Behold, I stand at the door and knock. If anyone hears my voice and opens the door, then I will come in to him, and…

translations.web: They were willing therefore to receive him into the boat. Immediately the boat was at the land where they were going.
translations.bsb: Then they were willing to take Him into the boat, and at once the boat reached the shore where they were heading.
translations.kjv: Then they willingly received him into the ship: and immediately the ship was at the land whither they went.
translations.asv: They were willing therefore to receive him into the boat: and straightway the boat was at the land whither they were going.
